interpretation_limits: Two fixed Expert seeds share restored Native root RNG; not independent hidden worlds.
Only descriptive retrospective evidence, no strategic indifference or true optimal-action claim.
Sampling variation, source confounding and continuation-policy mismatch are separate.
More Expert samples cannot by itself change Q under Expert into Q under repeated learned policy.
weighting: Equal owners; action means within root; pair fractions within ranking-eligible root then equal-owner mean. Raw pair counts only descriptive; no independent-pair intervals.
